# Chitinid
An industrious hymenoptera species, the Chitinid are strong and diligent. Thanks to evolution, they have grown an acute resistance to radiation, but not without its side effects.
## Benefits
- Takes 80% less Radiation, and 10% less Slash, Blunt and Piercing damage. - They possess a bio light.
## Drawbacks
- They take 15% more Shock damage due to their biology. - Thanks to their overactive systems they get hungry 33% faster. - The cold does not agree with their biology and makes their movement sluggish the colder it gets, the cold also harms them more than others. - Bug Blood.
